Books: ttt = Trích Thiên Tủy (bản dịch Việt), tvh = Thiệu Vĩ Hoa, Dự Đoán Theo Tứ Trụ, zz = 八字真宗, WEB:CTBG = 穷通宝鉴 (zh.wikisource snapshot, sources_web/). 'engine' says which side the engine follows today. Shape agreed with the main session: topics[] {id, topic, kind, sides[{school, statement, cite, quote, book, page | chapter}], engine}. kind: dieu_hau | dung_than | cach | luc_than | bang. A TVH điều hậu side has quote null (a table cell, no sentence to quote).
